channel.title: Wartabiye TV
channel.description: Wararka Soomaaliya, Afrika, adduunka iyo ciyaaraha.

item.title: Bayern Munich oo dhib ku jirta: Harry Kane iyo Michael Olise oo dhaawac ku baxay ciyaarta Köln
item.description: Xiddigaha Bayern Munich Harry Kane iyo Michael Olise ayaa labaduba dhaawac ku baxay Jimcihii ciyaartii Bundesliga ee ay kooxdu garoonkeeda ku martigelisay 1. FC Köln, afar maalmood ka hor safarka Champions League ee Lille.

item.title: Tom Brady oo wada-hadal heer sare ah kula jira Chelsea si uu u iibsado saami yar oo kooxda ah
item.description: Halyeeyga kubadda cagta Mareykanka (NFL) Tom Brady ayaa la sheegay inuu ku jiro wada-hadallo heer sare ah oo uu ku doonayo inuu iibsado saami yar oo kooxda Chelsea ah, kaddib markii uu bishan iska iibiyay saamigiisii kooxda Birmingham City.

item.title: Jabuuti oo sheegtay in ciidamadeeda AUSSOM ay ka hortageen la wareegidda garoonka Beledweyne
item.description: Safaaradda Jabuuti ee Soomaaliya ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in ciidamadeeda ka tirsan AUSSOM ay iska caabiyeen weerar lagu qaaday garoonka diyaaradaha Ugaas Khaliif ee Beledweyne 19 November, isla markaana ay ka hortageen in garoonka gacanta lagu dhigo.

item.title: Al Nassr 1-3 Al Ahli: Cristiano Ronaldo oo gaaray 986 gool balse ganaax ka khasaariyay
item.description: Cristiano Ronaldo ayaa Jimcihii gaaray 986 gool oo xirfaddiisa ah kaddib markii uu gool u dhaliyay Al Nassr, balse kooxdiisa ayaa 3-1 looga adkaaday Al Ahli ciyaar dib loo dhigay oo ka tirsan toddobaadka 9aad ee Saudi Pro League.

item.title: GOGOSHII WADA-HADALKA OO WALI LA HESHIIS LA’YAHAY: MAXAY TAHAY TALLAABADA XIGTA EE MADAXWEYNE XASAN SHEEKH?
item.description: Khilaafka siyaasadeed ee u dhexeeya Dowladda Federaalka Soomaaliya iyo dhinacyada mucaaradka ayaa galay marxalad cusub, kaddib markii ay soo baxeen warar muujinaya in Golaha Mustaqbalka Soomaaliyeed uusan weli isku raacin qaabka iyo shuruudaha lagu geli karo wada-hadalka uu Madaxweyne Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud ku baaqay.

item.title: CONMEBOL oo si wadajir ah u taageertay Gianni Infantino doorashada guddoomiyaha FIFA
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta Koonfurta Ameerika (CONMEBOL) ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqay in 10-ka dal ee ka tirsan ay si wadajir ah u taageerayaan dib-u-doorashada Gianni Infantino oo ah guddoomiyaha FIFA, doorashada 18 March 2027.

item.title: Liverpool: Van Dijk, Frimpong iyo Gravenberch oo diyaar u ah Man Utd, Van Dijk-na mustaqbalkiisa ma hubo
item.description: Tababaraha Liverpool Andoni Iraola ayaa sheegay in Virgil van Dijk, Jeremie Frimpong iyo Ryan Gravenberch ay u diyaar noqon karaan ciyaarta Axadda ee Manchester United, halka Van Dijk uu sheegay inaanu weli ogayn halka uu xilli ciyaareedka soo socda ku ciyaari doono.

item.title: Venezuela oo diiday awoodda Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee ICJ ee khilaafka Essequibo, una baaqday wada-hadal Guyana
item.description: Dowladda Venezuela ayaa Jimcihii mar kale ku adkaysatay inay diiddan tahay go'aankii garqaadka ee 1899 ee ku saabsan gobolka lagu muransan yahay ee Essequibo, kuna dhawaaqday inaysan aqoonsanayn awoodda Maxkamadda Caalamiga ah ee Caddaaladda (ICJ) ee khilaafka dhulka ay la leedahay Guyana.

item.title: Trump oo ku hanjabay inuu mamnuuco shirkadaha Mareykanka ee xarumaha xogta AI ka dhisa dibadda
item.description: Madaxweyne Donald Trump ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu mamnuuci doono in shirkadaha Mareykanka ay xarumaha xogta ee sirdoonka macmalka ah (AI) ka dhisaan dalal shisheeye, isagoo ku hanjabay canshuur aad u weyn shirkadaha tiknoolajiyada ee sidaas sameeya.

item.title: Nin Hindi ah oo Mareykanka lagu xukumay in ka badan 19 sano shirqool dil oo lagu beegsaday hoggaamiye Sikh ah
item.description: Maxkamad federaal ah oo ku taal Manhattan ayaa Jimcihii Nikhil Gupta, oo u dhashay Hindiya, ku xukuntay 235 bilood oo xarig ah, kaddib markii uu qiray inuu ka qayb qaatay shirqool lagu doonayay in lagu dilo Gurpatwant Singh Pannun, oo ah hoggaamiye Sikh ah oo ku nool New York.

item.title: Uganda: Afhayeenka hay'adda daawooyinka Abiaz Rwamwiri oo damiin lagu sii daayay
item.description: Maxkamadda La-dagaallanka Musuqmaasuqa ee Uganda ayaa Jimcihii damiin ku sii daysay Abiaz Rwamwiri, maareeyaha xiriirka dadweynaha ee Hay'adda Qaranka ee Daawooyinka (NDA), oo lagu soo eedeeyay xisaab been abuur ah iyo carqaladeynta baaritaan.

item.title: NFL: Drake Maye oo lafta lugta ka jabtay, Patriots-na waxay sidoo kale waayi doonaan A.J. Brown
item.description: Quarterback-ka New England Patriots Drake Maye ayaa laga helay jab lafta fibula ee lugta midig, taas oo la filayo inay ka fogeyso garoonka inta badan xilli ciyaareedka caadiga ah ee NFL, halka A.J. Brown uu dhaawac muruq ah dartiis toddobaadyo maqnaan doono.

item.title: Formula 1 oo si rasmi ah ugu laabanaysa matoorada V8 sannadka 2030 kaddib heshiis wadajir ah
item.description: Hay'adda FIA ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday heshiis wadajir ah oo ay la gaartay Formula One Management (FOM), kooxaha iyo shirkadaha samaysa matoorada, kaas oo ku saabsan in Formula 1 ay sannadka 2030 u gudubto matoor V8 turbo ah oo 2.1 litir ah.

item.title: Taageere Liverpool oo maxkamaddu ka fasaxday eedda aflagaadada cunsuriyadeed ee Antoine Semenyo
item.description: Maxkamad ku taal magaalada Liverpool ayaa Jimcihii sheegtay in aanu dembi galin nin taageere u ah Liverpool oo lagu eedeeyay inuu cunsuriyad ku aflagaadeeyay Antoine Semenyo, kaddib markii ciyaaryahanku uu ka noqday taageeridda dacwadda.

item.title: Pochettino oo ballanqaaday kubbad geesinimo leh shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay Manchester United
item.description: Tababaraha cusub ee Manchester United Mauricio Pochettino ayaa Jimcihii ku ballanqaaday shirkiisii jaraa'id ee ugu horreeyay in kooxdu ay ciyaari doonto kubbad geesinimo leh, ka hor ciyaartiisa ugu horreysa ee Axadda ee garoonka Anfield ee Liverpool.

item.title: NFL: Arizona Cardinals oo laga yaabo inay bilaabaan quarterback-kii afraad shan toddobaad gudahood
item.description: Kooxda Arizona Cardinals ayaa laga yaabaa inay Axadda ciyaarta Kansas City Chiefs ku bilaabaan quarterback-kii afraad ee kala duwan shan toddobaad gudahood, kaddib markii rookie-ga Carson Beck uu dhabarka ka dhaawacmay.

item.title: NFL: Indianapolis Colts oo sii daayay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, Anthony Richardson oo noqonaya bilaabaha
item.description: Kooxda Indianapolis Colts ayaa Jimcihii ku dhawaaqday inay sii daysay quarterback-ka Daniel Jones, maalin kaddib guuldarradii 26-3 ee ay ka soo gaartay Houston Texans, waxayna Anthony Richardson u magacawday bilaabaha cusub.

item.title: Chelsea oo ganaax £150,000 ah lagu riday heeso takoor diimeed ah oo taageerayaasheedu ku qaadeen ciyaar FA Cup
item.description: Ururka Kubadda Cagta England (FA) ayaa Jimcihii Chelsea ku riday ganaax dhan £150,000 kaddib heeso ka dhan ah Kaatooligga iyo Ayrishka oo taageerayaasheedu ku qaadeen guushii kooxda ee wareegga saddexaad ee FA Cup ee garoonka Charlton bishii January.

item.title: NFL: Puka Nacua oo qalliin jilibka loogu sameeyay, Rams-na bilooyin ayuu ka maqnaan doonaa
item.description: Tababaraha Los Angeles Rams Sean McVay ayaa Jimcihii sheegay in xiddigga kooxda Puka Nacua qalliin loogu sameeyay seedda MCL ee jilibka, uuna ka maqnaan doono garoonka muddo labo bilood ah.

item.title: Kenya: FKF iyo Darajani Gogo oo heshiis gaaray, horyaalka NSL-na wuxuu bilaabmayaa toddobaadka soo socda
item.description: Xiriirka Kubadda Cagta Kenya (FKF) iyo kooxda Darajani Gogo ayaa heshiis gaaray kaas oo u oggolaanaya in xilli ciyaareedka 2026/27 ee horyaalka heerka labaad ee National Super League (NSL) uu bilaabmo toddobaadka soo socda.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U17: Talyaaniga oo 6-0 ku jebiyay Jamaica kulankiisii ugu horreeyay
item.description: Xulka Talyaaniga ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa Jimcihii 6-0 kaga adkaaday Jamaica kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Koobka Adduunka ee ka socda Qatar.

item.title: MADASHA SAMATABIXINTA OO MAANTA HOTEL JAZEERA KU YEELANAYSA KULAN MUHIIM AH OO KU SAABSAN FARRIINTA MADAXWEYNAHA
item.description: Muqdisho – Madasha Samatabixinta ayaa maanta kulan muhiim ah ku yeelanaysa Hotel Jazeera ee magaalada Muqdisho, kaas oo diiradda lagu saarayo ka tashiga farriin uu dhawaan soo diray Madaxweynaha Jamhuuriyadda Federaalka Soomaaliya, Xasan Sheekh Maxamuud, kuna saabsan gogosha wadahadalka siyaasadeed ee uu ku baaqay.

item.title: Duqa New York Zohran Mamdani oo seedda Achilles ka jaray isagoo kubadda cagta ciyaaraya
item.description: Duqa magaalada New York Zohran Mamdani ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuu seedda Achilles ka jaray kulan saaxiibtinimo oo kubadda cagta ah oo uu Khamiistii ciyaaray, wuxuuna ku yimid shir jaraa'id isagoo ku tiirsan ulo.

item.title: Uganda oo baarlamaanka ka codsatay ogolaansho deyn Shs530 bilyan ah oo waddooyin lagu dhiso
item.description: Dowladda Uganda ayaa baarlamaanka ka codsatay inuu u oggolaado deyn gaaraysa Shs530 bilyan oo laga qaadanayo Citi Bank, si loo laamiyo 78.4 kiilomitir oo waddooyin ah oo ku yaalla degmooyinka Kanungu iyo Rubanda.

item.title: MotoGP Portugal: Álex Márquez oo hoggaamiyay tijaabada Portimão, Marc Márquez oo Sabtida horyaal noqon kara
item.description: Álex Márquez ayaa Jimcihii ugu dhaqsiyo badnaa tijaabada kahor isreebreebka Grand Prix-ga Portugal ee Portimão, halka walaalkiis Marc Márquez uu Sabtida ku guuleysan karo horyaalkiisa tobnaad ee adduunka.

item.title: Omar Berrada: Qaar ka mid ah dhaleeceynta taageerayaasha Man United waxay dhaafeen xadka
item.description: Maamulaha guud ee Manchester United Omar Berrada ayaa sheegay in qaar ka mid ah dhaleeceynta loo jeediyay hoggaanka kooxda ay ka gudubtay xadka, inkastoo uu fahmayo xanaaqa taageerayaasha.

item.title: Tennis: Carlos Alcaraz oo aan weli go'aamin inuu ka qeybgalo Davis Cup-ka
item.description: Xiddigga tennis-ka Spain Carlos Alcaraz ayaa Jimcihii sheegay inuusan weli go'aan ka gaarin inuu ka ciyaari doono Davis Cup-ka toddobaadyada soo socda, isagoo ammaanay xoogga xulka Jarmalka ee uu hoggaaminayo Alexander Zverev.

item.title: Koobka Adduunka U17: Spain oo 5-0 ku garaacday China, Tunkara oo gool qurux badan dhaliyay
item.description: Xulka Spain ee da'da ka yar 17 sano ayaa Jimcihii 5-0 kaga adkaaday China kulankiisii ugu horreeyay ee Koobka Adduunka ee ka socda Doha.

item.title: Ruto oo difaacay guddiga doorashooyinka IEBC, mucaaradkana ku baaqay inay keenaan siyaasado kale
item.description: Madaxweynaha Kenya William Ruto ayaa Jimcaha weerar culus ku qaaday hoggaamiyeyaasha mucaaradka ee dalabyo ka keenay guddiga madaxa-bannaan ee doorashooyinka iyo xuduudaha (IEBC), isagoo ku eedeeyay inay faragelin ku sameynayaan hay'adda.

item.title: Everton: Jack Grealish oo dib ugu soo laabtay kooxda ka hor kulanka Brentford
item.description: Tababaraha Everton David Moyes ayaa xaqiijiyay in Jack Grealish uu diyaar u yahay safarka kooxda ee Brentford Isniinta, kadib muddo uu kooxda kaga maqnaa arrin anshax.
